property_summary: Whenever a valid 10-ether fallback call lands on a block number divisible by 15, contract C must pay out its entire balance to the caller (so address(c).balance becomes 0); the mutant pays out on all other blocks instead, leaving a nonzero balance on divisible blocks.
change_summary: Replace the payout condition `block.number % 15 == 0` with `block.number % 15 != 0`, inverting when the transfer occurs.
